test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations released the World Social Protection Report (WSPR) 2024-2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Labour Organization**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **International Labour Organization (ILO)** is responsible for publishing the **World Social Protection Report (WSPR) 2024-2025**.
 
• This report provides a comprehensive analysis of the state of social protection systems worldwide, examining their coverage, benefits, and financing.
 
• The aim of the report is to highlight gaps in social protection and present actionable recommendations for improving access and equity in social security systems globally.
 
• The ILO is a specialized agency of the United Nations that focuses on promoting decent work, setting international labor standards, and advocating for social justice.
 
• The organization was established in **1919** and is headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations Security Council (UNSC)**

 
 
• The UNSC is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations, primarily responsible for maintaining international peace and security.
 
• It has 15 members, including 5 permanent members (China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States) and 10 non-permanent members elected for two-year terms.
 
• The UNSC adopts binding resolutions and can authorize military action, impose sanctions, or establish peacekeeping operations.
 
• It does not publish reports related to social protection systems.
 
 
 
• **World Health Organization (WHO)**
 
 
• The WHO is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health.
 
• It was established in 1948 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• The WHO publishes reports such as the World Health Report and the Global Health Observatory, focusing on health systems, disease prevention, and health equity.
 
• It does not release reports specifically on social protection systems.
 
 
 
• **International Monetary Fund (IMF)**
 
 
• The IMF is an international financial institution established in 1944 to promote global monetary cooperation, financial stability, and economic growth.
 
• It provides financial support and policy advice to member countries to address economic challenges.
 
• The IMF publishes reports such as the World Economic Outlook and Global Financial Stability Report, which focus on macroeconomic issues.
 
• It does not focus on social protection systems or publish reports like the WSPR.
